newPlatforms.activityVerification: CIUT's official Schedule page publishes a full seven-day schedule with current programming including The New Music Hour, Global Rhythms, Electric Sense, DJ Mixes, Reggae Riddims, Groove Concept Radio and Sticky Icky Reggae. newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: A human must recheck CIUT's current submission instruction, confirm international eligibility and all release-type, file, link, metadata, release-age, explicit-content and AI-origin rules, select a suitable MarcsMusic release, send manually only to newmusic@ciut.fm, avoid assuming that the general postal address is an authorized physical music-submission route, and stop if a login, CAPTCHA, mandatory payment, consent request or updated restriction appears.

deduplication.result: Repository code search and the complete open pull-request patch were checked for CIUT, CIUT 89.5 FM, ciut.fm, the official Contact path and newmusic@ciut.fm. No prior canonical music-submission-agent record or previous use of the dedicated submission mailbox was found. CIUT is stored once. The general station postal address remains adjacent contact information because the official page does not expressly authorize physical music submissions.

notes: The opportunity is publicly authorized and free-first but remains needs_manual_review because detailed delivery rules and international eligibility are not expressly confirmed.
